record.tooling: Web; no API for file ingest.

record.limits_note: no stated cap; PDF only for print interiors, EPUB/PDF for ebooks; retail partners reject >100 MB.
record.reliability_note: The uploaded file is not served back to you or anyone else — it exists only to be printed. A host that gives storage but not your bytes back is not storage.
